title: FI_Back2School2025
description: We partner with universities, student unions, and other organizations to provide verified relevant local content to our users and enabled them to connect with other students around them. We promote our Student channels during the event, which are hubs for campus news and peer connections, enhanced with in-app games, matchmaking, and offline events. A dedicated event post links all activities, channels, and partner content, updated throughout the campaign. With its strong local student base, Jodel delivers high value during B2S and beyond, making it ideal for App Store featuring in Finland.
